newsitem.title: USA: LTC Properties to sell stock.
newsitem.headline: LTC Properties to sell stock.

text.p: LTC Properties Inc said Friday it arranged for the sale of one million shares of common stock at a price of $17.75 per share in a registered direct placement which will result in net proceeds of about $17.36 million.
Net proceeds from the offering will be used to repay short-term debt under the company's revolving lines of credit.
The shares will be sold pursuant to LTC's effective shelf registration statement and are expected to settle on Jan. 15, 1997.

LTC Properties Inc. is a self-administered real estate investment trust that was organized to invest in long-term care and other health care related facilities through mortgage loans, facility leases and other transactions. As of Dec. 31, 1996, its portfolio included 248 skilled nursing facilities and 35 assisted living facilities in 32 states.
